steps.en: Install the nightly build (brew, AUR, or the curl download)
steps.zh: 装 nightly 版（brew、AUR 或 curl 直下）
导出一个重 JS 的页面

steps.en: Runs the page's JavaScript in V8 with XHR/Fetch, cookies and form clicks — no render engine involved
steps.zh: 在 V8 里跑页面 JS 与 XHR/Fetch，全程没有渲染引擎

steps.en: Prints the settled DOM as HTML or Markdown in ~120 MB of RAM
steps.zh: 以约 120 MB 内存输出稳定后的 DOM 文本

value.en: Thousands of JS pages scraped on a fraction of Chrome's memory (vendor-reported ~16x lighter) — one small binary, no browser fleet
value.zh: 上千个 JS 页面用 Chrome 零头的内存抓完——一个小二进制，没有机群

sources: README.md Package Managers (brew install lightpanda-io/browser/lightpanda; yay -S lightpanda-nightly-bin) and Download from the nightly builds (curl -L -o lightpanda https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser/releases/download/nightly/lightpanda-x86_64-linux && chmod a+x ./lightpanda; ./lightpanda version)
README.md Dump a URL (./lightpanda fetch --obey-robots --dump html --log-format pretty --log-level info https://demo-browser.lightpanda.io/campfire-commerce/; --dump markdown; --wait-* options)
README.md Benchmarks (933 pages on AWS m5.large: peak 123MB vs 2GB, 5s vs 46s) and Start a CDP server (puppeteer.connect via browserWSEndpoint ws://127.0.0.1:9222)
README.md Why Lightpanda (no graphical rendering engine; built on v8, libcurl, html5ever)
